items.title: Basin rig count up two as prices decline
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up two this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 275 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 253 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is down three from last week at 601 rigs. A year ago, 549 rigs were active. items.title: What Does Baker Hughes (BKR) Winning The Cronos Cyprus Contract Mean?
items.summary: Baker Hughes (NasdaqGS:BKR) has been awarded a major contract by Eni for the Cronos deepwater gas project offshore Cyprus. The agreement covers subsea production systems and associated services to support Eni's accelerated development timetable for Cronos. The win expands Baker Hughes' role in Eastern Mediterranean offshore gas projects and broadens its subsea equipment footprint in the region.
